data_scope: ALL StudyF: 10 subjects x 3 Sessions x 3 Train/CBCol EDFs = 90 files; StudyB excluded; no final Test
blink_interval_source: per-EDF blink_candidates.csv and blink_epoch_links.csv in preprocessing input manifest

blink_detector.status: unvalidated engineering candidates; fixed parameters; no data-distribution fitting

blink_policy_timing: existing conservative uniform epoch-end guard from three_policy_comparison; no future candidate hindsight
common_quality: reuse faults_only common baseline: startup, incomplete, nonfinite, filter recovery, known-by-decision raw constant/zero; no new lower-PTP or jump rule

features.feature_order: channel-major, then increasing window time; samples satisfy bin_start <= sample/fs < bin_end
features.units: uV; MNE/NPZ input V converted by 1e6

split.rule: first floor(2*n/3) complete trials train, remainder validate; no cross-subject models
split.purge: if raw sample overlap or training-policy lookahead reaches validation samples, fail rather than silently dropping validation characters

swlda.implementation: project-owned forward/backward OLS stepwise linear discriminant; binary response 0/1, not ordinary LDA
swlda.standardize: training retained epochs only, population std; constant features excluded
swlda.reproduction_limit: classic stepwise SWLDA algorithm on requested features, not a bit-for-bit BCI2000 implementation

character_evidence.rule: mean score when character flashed minus mean score when not flashed
character_evidence.rejected_flash: no score, no evidence update; never zero imputed
character_evidence.stopping: full character end only; output after all policy confirmation times and SelectedTarget boundary

auc.overall: macro over model-fold AUCs; do not pool incomparable per-model score scales

selection: All local StudyF Train EDFs, exhaustiveness asserted before detection; fixed chronological 2/3 complete-character split within subject/Session
